known_issues.title: V1/V2 duplicate billing on cache hit
known_issues.detail: When V2 fires (r_changed=True) with same model+prompt as V1, V2 hits cache. No new model computation occurs, but logical billing records 100 tokens for V2 (historical cache response). Total tokens billed overstates real cost.
known_issues.evidence: 1900a08 S2: V1 sha=b2b96da3, V2 sha=b2b96da3, V2 source=cache, both billed 100 tokens
known_issues.impact: C is inflated by cache-hit charges for superseded/refresh calls
known_issues.min_fix: Separate real_tokens (only non-cache, non-injected) from logical_tokens (all billed). Report both. Use real_tokens for the C objective in search.

known_issues.title: r_changed does not distinguish A→B→A from A→B→C
known_issues.detail: r_changed is set when ANY intermediate r output differs. If R2 changes r from A to B, then R3 restores to A, r_changed remains True (cumulative). V2 fires unnecessarily.
known_issues.evidence: 1900a08 S3 tested A→A→C (not the required A→B→A)
known_issues.impact: Unnecessary V2 execution in rare restoration cases
known_issues.min_fix: Change r_changed to compare FINAL r output vs ORIGINAL r output: r_changed = (last_r_answer != first_r_answer). This correctly handles A→B→A (False) and A→B→C (True).

known_issues.title: billing_inflation conflates cache, injected, and real retry
known_issues.detail: billing_inflation = logical_calls - computed_requests mixes cache-hit charges, fault-injection entries, and genuine superseded calls. Not a clean measure of wasted cost.
known_issues.evidence: S3: billing_inflation=4 includes 3 fault entries + 1 superseded
known_issues.impact: Cannot use billing_inflation as a reliable cost metric
known_issues.min_fix: Report four separate metrics (see metric definitions below). Do not compute a single inflation number.

physical_model_cost.name: real_tokens
physical_model_cost.definition: sum of usage.total_tokens from calls where source=real (not cache, not injected_fault)
physical_model_cost.search_objective: YES — this is the C objective for Pareto search

logical_execution_count.name: logical_calls
logical_execution_count.definition: total number of keys in the execution ledger (includes cache hits and fault injections)

cumulative_service_latency.name: service_L
cumulative_service_latency.definition: sum of per-call latency_s across all calls in the execution ledger (serial estimate)

end_to_end_wall_clock.name: wall_L
end_to_end_wall_clock.definition: time.monotonic() difference from task start to task end (includes model switching, queueing)
end_to_end_wall_clock.search_objective: YES — this is the L objective for Pareto search

metric_definitions.note: C = real_tokens (not logical_tokens); L = wall_L (not service_L). service_L and logical_calls reported as diagnostics.

go_conditions: ISSUE-1 fixed: real_tokens separated from logical_tokens in per-task results
ISSUE-2 fixed: r_changed compares final vs original r output
ISSUE-3 fixed: four separate metrics reported (not single inflation)
GPU available and no conflicting processes
Budget approved: 200 real LLM calls for smoke
smoke_limitations: 8 tasks is not enough for statistical significance
Single fault seed — no robustness across fault draws
Search comparison on 10 configs is illustrative, not conclusive
Results apply to this DAG topology, not generalizable to other structures
